faqs.question: How do I unlock the rest of the videos after watching the free Lesson 1?
faqs.answer: Every newly registered or signed-in student can watch Lesson 1 (1 MUST WATCH) completely free. To unlock the remaining course videos and receive Google Drive access on your sign-up email, send GH₵ 50 (for AI Website Development or AI Video Creation) to MTN Mobile Money 0551464715 (EK TECH SOLUTIONS) and submit your Transaction ID inside your dashboard.

faqs.question: Why do I need to use my sign-up email for payment verification?
faqs.answer: Once our administrator verifies your Mobile Money transfer, access to the remaining premium course videos in Instructor Emmanuel Sansah’s Google Drive library (emmanuelsansah020@gmail.com) is granted directly to your registered sign-up email address.

faqs.question: How long does Mobile Money payment verification take?
faqs.answer: Payments are manually verified by our administration team to protect students and prevent duplicate transaction IDs. Verification typically completes within 15 minutes to 2 hours, and you can also message 0551464715 on WhatsApp for urgent assistance.

faqs.question: Do I receive a certificate after completing a course?
faqs.answer: Yes. Upon completing all required lessons and passing the course quiz or practical assessment, an official EK TECH SOLUTIONS certificate signed by Emmanuel Sansah is issued in your Student Dashboard.

faqs.question: Do I need coding experience before joining AI Website Development?
faqs.answer: No prior programming background is required. Emmanuel Sansah walks you step by step from the free intro video through building, hosting, custom domains, and troubleshooting.
